observed_problem.detail: Pre-repair Python rejected int(2**53) but accepted float(2**53), while the retained independent Node reference rejects the same integer-valued Number outside Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. The same mathematical value could therefore be admitted or rejected based only on host-language numeric type.

unusual_experiment.counterhypothesis_rejected: Python int-versus-float representation is harmless because equal JSON/I-JSON numbers always share the same admission domain.

repair.law: integer-valued binary64 values outside the I-JSON safe-integer range fail closed regardless of Python int/float representation
